title.narrative: Preventing Human Trafficking and Smuggling of Human Beings in Nigeria

description.narrative: 1. Increasing public awareness and access to rescue support – sensitizing 40,000 vulnerable individuals, training 180 community members put information about assistance in the hands of 700 returned victims and survivors of trafficking. 2. Economic impact through training and business opportunities – targeting 600 returnees/survivors to increase their hire ability and life skills and 100 returnees/survivors for educational advancement. 3. Changing the landscape of knowledge-sharing through High Level Advocacy Engagement and Capacity Building – knowledge-sharing with 50 industry experts across counter human trafficking organizations, government, and law enforcement and capacity building of MeCAHT staff.

title.narrative: Output 1.1: Awareness and campaign

Indicator 1-3: Impacting the perspective and behaviour of 40,000 people from 50 communities in 6 States toward human trafficking, its victims, risks and precautions. Also 40,000 people from 50 communities in 6 states are sensitized about the risks and signs of human trafficking, by watching the film and completing pre- and post- film and training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour. Lastly, prevention by identifying trafficking and smuggling cases and reporting of suspicious activities or decrease in trafficking incidents in the 6 states

target.value: Conduct awareness campaigns and educational initiatives to sensitize an additional 10,000 (for composite total of 20,000) people from 50 communities in 6 states about the risks and signs of human trafficking, using pre- and post- training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour.

actual.value: 15,472 individuals reached across 6 communities across five (5) States using the "I Wish I Knew" movie, highlighting survivors' stories, traffickers' tactics, and ways to identify and report trafficking cases.

target.value: Conduct awareness campaigns and educational initiatives to sensitize 10,000 people from 50 communities in 6 states about the risks and signs of human trafficking, using pre- and post- training questionnaires as well as Q&A surveys to determine effectiveness and impact on perspective and future behaviour

actual.value: A groundbreaking awareness campaign reached 14,128 individuals through the impactful I Wish I Knew movie, highlighting survivors stories, traffickers tactics, and ways to identify and report trafficking cases. Pre and post questionnaires evaluated the campaigns effectiveness, revealing significant improvements in participants understanding and informing future initiatives. The project has also reached 176 people directly through stakeholders engagement and movie premiere. 32 episodes of the I Wish I Knew radio program have been aired on Eagles FM which has a listenership of over 400,000 per hour.

title.narrative: 3.1 High Level Advocacy Engagement and Capacity Building

1. Increase in the understanding of human trafficking and smuggling between 50 Nigerian and Danish stakeholders documented by MeCAHT and EXIST. 2. 20 MeCAHT staff have improved operational efficiency in financial competence, project design & management, proposal writing, effective reporting, leadership and responsibility. Consequently, staff are able to maintain the expected standards required for managing larger grants and to communicate more effectively between team members, partners, networks, donors, communities and other stakeholders.

target.value: 1. Host 1 high level advocacy event for 25 stakeholders like the Danish Centre against Human Trafficking, Danish Police, Nigerian diaspora community, Nigerian victims and survivors of human trafficking and smuggling and 6 MeCAHT staff in Denmark to advocate for better coordination of support for victims and survivors of human trafficking and smuggling. 2. Hold a capacity building training for 20 MeCAHT staff Proposal and Report Writing in Nigeria. 3. Mentoring, training assessment and strategic planning for new learnings by EXIST

actual.value: Successfully coordinated a high-level anti-trafficking advocacy movie preview in Denmark in April 2025, strengthening stakeholder visibility, awareness, and engagement on counter-trafficking efforts.
